scripts.copy-traces-from-routed: sh -c 'set -vxe;for f in ./${npm_package_config_VERSION}/kicad/routed/[!_]*.kicad_pcb; do echo "${f}" && python3 ./${npm_package_config_VERSION}/ergogen/kb_ergogen_helper/ergogen_helper.py --no-backup copy-traces "${f}" ./${npm_package_config_VERSION}/kicad/$(basename "${f}"); done'
scripts.fab-jlcpcb: sh -c 'set -vxe;for f in ./${npm_package_config_VERSION}/kicad/routed/[!_]*.kicad_pcb; do echo "${f}" && kikit fab jlcpcb --nametemplate "ha-harmony-remote_{boardTitle}_{date}" "${f}" dist/${npm_package_config_VERSION}/kicad/jlcpcb/; done'
scripts.update-pcbs: sh -c 'set -vxe;for f in dist/${npm_package_config_VERSION}/ergogen/pcbs/[!_]*.kicad_pcb; do echo ${f} && python3 ./${npm_package_config_VERSION}/ergogen/kb_ergogen_helper/ergogen_helper.py --no-backup update-pcb ${f}; done'
scripts.watch-and-copy-pcbs-to-kicad: sh -c 'set -vxe;nodemon --ext .js,.yaml --watch ./${npm_package_config_VERSION}/ergogen/config.yaml --exec "npm run build && npm run copy-pcbs-to-kicad"'
